## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install comm_core in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure comm_core package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to comm_core
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/comm-core):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/comm-core.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/comm-core)

``` sh
$ conda install -c Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh comm_core
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/comm-core/)

``` sh
$ pip install comm_core
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/comm-core)’s
[pages](https://Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh.github.io/comm-core/). Additionally
you can find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/Ahmed-Khaled-Saleh/comm-core) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/comm-core/) respectively.
